notes.title: Royal Poker Week is LIVE!
notes.content:
With only 10s, Jacks, Queens, Kings and Aces, do you have what it takes to win like a Royal?

Wait... there's more?? YES...

Beat the upstarts and win  your Crowns. Collect as many as you can to win the Jackpots worth up to 250 BILLION or more!

notes.title: FACE-OFF and ULTIMATE FACE-OFF Tournaments LIVE!
notes.content:
Two players, Equal stacks, Fast paced, Winner takes all!

Want more? You got it!

Win trophies as you play, earn points and they who reach the top 100 on the leaderboard share a jackpot worth up to 10's of BILLIONS!

Do you have what it takes? Yes? PROVE IT!

notes.title: Its TOURNAMENT WEEK and its LIVE!
notes.content:
Whether you like playing with five, three, or just head to head action there's a tournament for you!

Play the Winners,  Empire or King Tournament and collect as many trophies as you can.

Want more? Of course you do...

Keep winning trophies to split a share of the tournament progressives worth up to 45 BILLION or more!
